Dots: manually read published group means; bars: reading widths, not study SD or personal labs.
Dots in conditional mode: real lab observations, separate from assumed model curves; never used to fit B/A. Relative mode omits concentration dots.

Band: explored 15-candidate range, not a 90% human confidence or prediction interval. Shading: no preceding eligible dose, or more than 8 h since the latest dose; the 8–24 h tail is highly uncertain. M2 retrospective shape evidence does not establish personal absolute accuracy; it does not always beat M1.
